summary: Arcus Biosciences filed an Item 8.01 Form 8-K on October 20, 2026, disclosing new clinical data from the ARC-20 platform study of casdatifan in clear cell renal cell carcinoma as of a September 4, 2026 cutoff. First-line casdatifan plus zimberelimab (n=30) showed 86%/69% six- and 12-month landmark PFS and 50% cORR; second-line casdatifan plus cabozantinib showed 14.5-month median PFS and 77% 18-month OS; late-line monotherapy showed 35-month median OS. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms were disclosed. This is a routine clinical-update current report, not a special situation.
